description: A remote gate commits red or green, tries itself first, and says what it did in one object

accepted.by: gary (standing instruction: always accept the ADRs and specs; recorded by the implementing agent, 2026-11-23)

specs.description: A remote pass ends with one result object naming the commit, the remote head and the counts
specs.given: a project whose `test.remote` runs the gate in a clone of the pushed commit, on branch `feat` tracking origin, with a change to `src/a.rs`
specs.when: `hexa do gate --files src/a.rs -e 'bash ci/green.sh' -m fix --no-land` runs, where `ci/green.sh` prints a cargo summary of 2 passed
specs.then: it exits 0; the last line of stdout is one JSON object with `ok: true`, `mode: remote`, `expect: green`, `commit` equal to the new HEAD, `remote_head` equal to it, and `tests` `{passed: 2, failed: 0}`

specs.description: A failing remote gate's result object carries code, hint, field, retryable and the first failure
specs.when: `hexa do gate --files src/a.rs -e 'bash ci/red.sh' -m fix` runs, where `ci/red.sh` prints `test b ... FAILED` and a cargo summary of 1 passed, 1 failed, and exits 101
specs.then: it exits non-zero; the last stdout line is a JSON object with `ok: false`, `code: remote-gate-failed`, a non-empty `hint`, `field: --evidence`, `retryable: false`, `tests` `{passed: 1, failed: 1}` and `first_failure` containing `test b ... FAILED`; HEAD has not moved and `src/a.rs` is still uncommitted

specs.description: An uncounted remote pass says uncounted in its object
specs.when: `hexa do gate --files src/a.rs -e 'test -f src/a.rs' -m fix --uncounted --no-land` runs
specs.then: it exits 0; the result object has `ok: true` and `tests` `{uncounted: true}`

specs.description: A remote gate that ran zero tests is vacuous, and commits nothing
specs.when: `hexa do gate --files src/a.rs -e 'bash ci/zero.sh' -m fix` runs, where `ci/zero.sh` prints `running 0 tests` and a cargo summary of 0 passed and exits 0
specs.then: it exits non-zero; the result object has `code: vacuous-gate` and `field: --evidence`; HEAD has not moved

specs.description: The runner is sent the commit on the scratch ref, and the scratch ref is gone after a pass
specs.then: the runner's log names the result's `commit`; `git ls-remote origin 'refs/heads/hexa-gate/*'` is empty afterwards

specs.description: A runner whose output does not name the commit is refused, and the scratch ref is gone
specs.given: a project whose `test.remote` runs the command in the current checkout and prints a commit id that is not the candidate
specs.when: `hexa do gate --files src/a.rs -e 'bash ci/green.sh' -m fix` runs
specs.then: it exits non-zero; the result object has `code: remote-runner-wrong-commit` and `retryable: true`; HEAD has not moved; no `hexa-gate/` ref is on origin

specs.description: A remote pass reads the branch's head back from the remote
specs.then: `git ls-remote origin refs/heads/feat` names the result's `commit`, and the result's `remote_head` equals it

specs.description: A refused branch push fails the verb with push-refused
specs.given: the same project, whose origin refuses any push to `refs/heads/feat` and accepts `refs/heads/hexa-gate/*`
specs.then: it exits non-zero; the result object has `code: push-refused` and `retryable: true`; origin's `feat` is unchanged; no `hexa-gate/` ref is left

specs.description: A refused scratch push commits nothing
specs.given: the same project, whose origin refuses every push
specs.then: it exits non-zero; the result object has `code: push-refused`; HEAD has not moved; the runner was never invoked

specs.description: --expect-red commits tests that fail on assertions
specs.given: the same project, with a new test file `tests/t.rs`
specs.when: `hexa do gate --files tests/t.rs -e 'bash ci/red.sh' -m 'test: first' --expect-red` runs
specs.then: it exits 0; HEAD is one new commit holding `tests/t.rs`; origin's `feat` names it; the result object has `ok: true`, `expect: red`, `tests` `{passed: 1, failed: 1}`; `main` is unchanged (a red commit never lands)

specs.given: the same project, with a new test file `tests/t.rs`
specs.when: `hexa do gate --files tests/t.rs -e 'bash ci/compile.sh' -m 'test: first' --expect-red` runs, where `ci/compile.sh` prints `error[E0425]: cannot find function` and `error: could not compile` and exits 101
specs.then: it exits non-zero; the result object has `code: red-not-a-test-failure`; HEAD has not moved; `tests/t.rs` is still untracked

specs.description: --expect-red refuses a gate that passes, and one that ran zero tests
specs.given: the same project, with a new test file `tests/t.rs`
specs.when: `--expect-red` runs once with `ci/green.sh` and once with `ci/zero.sh`
specs.then: both exit non-zero, with `code: not-red` and `code: vacuous-gate` respectively; HEAD has not moved

specs.when: `hexa do gate --files tests/t.rs -e 'bash ci/red.sh' -m x --expect-red --uncounted` runs
specs.then: it exits non-zero before anything runs; the runner was never invoked

specs.description: A red commit names `hexa spec red` as its next step
specs.then: the result object's `next` is `hexa spec red <ADR> <commit>` with the full commit id

specs.description: A red commit writes no spec record
specs.given: the same project, with a spec record `docs/specs/<id>.json` committed
specs.then: the spec record is byte-identical to before, and the tree has no other change

specs.description: --dry-run says what it would do and does none of it
specs.when: `hexa do gate --files src/a.rs -e 'bash ci/green.sh' -m fix --dry-run` runs
specs.then: it exits 0; the result object has `mode: dry-run`, `ok: true` and a `would` object whose `parent` is HEAD and whose `run` names the `test.remote` command; HEAD has not moved; origin's refs are unchanged; the runner was never invoked; `src/a.rs` is still uncommitted

specs.description: A dry run still refuses what the gate would refuse
specs.when: `hexa do gate --files src/b.rs -e 'bash ci/green.sh' -m fix --dry-run` runs
specs.then: it exits non-zero; the result object has `code: nothing-to-commit` and `field: --files`

specs.given: a project with `src/a.rs` staged, with and without `test.remote`
specs.when: the pre-bash hook sees `git commit -m x`
specs.then: the refusal names `hexa do gate` and `--expect-red` in both cases

specs.description: A prose-only commit is not refused and names nothing
specs.given: a project under `test.remote` with only `docs/x.md` staged
specs.when: the pre-bash hook sees `git commit -m x`
specs.then: it exits 0 and its output does not name `--expect-red`
